lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, forming a dense grid-like arrangement in the mid-flank area above the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a series of anchor nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the visible flank, each defined by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light crests and darker ventral shadows.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin exhibits a high-contrast density of smaller, high-luminance spots that are more tightly packed than those on the lateral flank.
